seo.sub: 100% Client-Side Browser Calculation · Zero Server Uploads · Privacy First for Confidential Contracts
seo.guide_title: What is a PDF Cross-Page Stamp & How Does It Work?
seo.guide_text: A cross-page stamp (also known as a seam seal or page-spanning stamp) is applied across the outer edges of consecutive multi-page documents like legal contracts, tenders, and official forms. By splitting a single seal across multiple pages, it prevents tampering or unauthorized page swapping. PDFQFZ automatically calculates page counts and edge splits in your browser for seamless stamping.

faqs.q: Is it safe to use this tool for confidential PDF contracts? Will files be uploaded?
faqs.a: It is 100% safe and confidential. PDFQFZ operates entirely on client-side WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas technology. All PDF processing and seal splitting occur inside your browser memory. No files are ever sent to any remote server.

faqs.q: How can I adjust the stamp position and size across multi-page PDFs?
faqs.a: After uploading your PDF and stamp image, select 'Ride-Seam' mode. Use the config panel to customize stamp size (mm), vertical position (%), opacity, and edge alignment with real-time interactive preview.

faqs.q: What happens if my PDF document has dozens of pages?
faqs.a: Our tool features an intelligent auto-grouping mechanism. When page counts exceed the maximum split limit (e.g. 20 pages), the system divides the stamp into optimal sub-groups so every split segment remains crisp and clear.

faqs.q: What stamp image formats are supported? How do I handle white backgrounds?
faqs.a: We support PNG (transparent) and JPG images. If using a JPG stamp with a white background, enable 'Auto White Removal' and 'Multiply Blend Mode'. The tool will automatically strip the white fill and overlay ink naturally over text.
